title: Isolation of Adult Pig Ventricular Myocytes
author: Robert Harvey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba8iihue

steps.title: Sedate and anesthetize pig
steps.instruction: Sedate the adult pig (25–50 kg) with Telezol 500 mg intramuscularly; administer atropine 1 mg subcutaneously to control secretions and atropine 200 mg intravenously to facilitate tracheal intubation; then anesthetize with isoflurane 2–4 % inhalation.

steps.title: Prepare surgical field
steps.instruction: Shave the chest area and wash with betadine antiseptic solution; verify loss of corneal and pain reflexes to confirm deep anesthesia; peel back skin over the left chest wall, make an incision between the 4th and 5th ribs, and insert rib spreaders to hold the incision open.

steps.title: Excise heart into cardioplegia
steps.instruction: Open the pericardium, remove the heart, and immediately place it in ice‑cold cardioplegia solution containing (mM) NaCl 130, KCl 27, MgSO₄ 1.2, KH₂PO₄ 1.2, glucose 50, HEPES 6 (pH 7.4); rinse the heart free of blood and transport to the laboratory in the same cold cardioplegia on ice.

steps.title: Dissect left ventricular free wall
steps.instruction: Dissect the heart to isolate a section of the left ventricular free wall supplied by the left anterior descending (LAD) coronary artery.

steps.title: Ligate leaking arteries and perfuse
steps.instruction: Ligate any leaking arteries at the periphery of the free wall to maintain perfusion pressure; continue constant‑pressure perfusion until the effluent is free of blood (≈10 min).

steps.title: Enzyme digestion (Ca²⁺‑free)
steps.instruction: Switch perfusion to a Ca²⁺‑free solution containing collagenase type 2 (~200 U ml⁻¹) and protease type XIV (~1 mg ml⁻¹) and perfuse for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Stop digestion with KB buffer
steps.instruction: Perfuse the tissue with enzyme‑free KB solution containing (mM) K‑glutamate 110, KH₂PO₄ 10, KCl 25, MgSO₄ 1.2, taurine 20, creatine 5, EGTA 0.5, glucose 20, HEPES 5 (pH 7.2) for 2 minutes to halt enzymatic activity.

steps.title: Remove and region‑separate tissue
steps.instruction: Remove the tissue from the Langendorff apparatus and separate it into regions as needed (top half for base of free wall, bottom half for apex).

steps.title: Mince, filter, and settle myocytes
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue into small pieces, mince with scissors, filter through a 500 µm polyester mesh, collect the filtrate containing isolated myocytes, and allow the cells to settle in KB solution at 37 °C for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend myocytes in Ca²⁺ solution
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet of isolated myocytes in a Ca²⁺‑containing solution for downstream experiments.

steps.title: Attach free wall to Langendorff (optional)
steps.instruction: Cannulate the proximal end of the LAD coronary artery to attach the ventricular free wall to a Langendorff apparatus and perfuse with Ca²⁺‑free solution containing (mM) NaCl 140, KCl 5.4, MgCl₂ 2.5, glucose 11, HEPES 5.5 (pH 7.4) maintained at 37 °C.
